resources.string: Connect a tunnel while chosen apps are open

While an app with a rule is open, auto-tunnel connects that rule\'s tunnel. It stays on until you close the app from your recent apps (swipe it away there); then the other auto-tunnel rules decide again. With several rule apps open, the most recently used one wins. Auto-tunnel must be on.
On. Sees apps the moment they open, in every profile: work profile, private space, Secure Folder.

Off. Recommended: instant, and the only way to see apps in the work profile, private space and Secure Folder. Quartz only reads which app is in front, nothing on screen. Tap, then turn on Quartz under installed or downloaded apps.
On. Lets a tunnel stay on until its app is closed from recent apps (main profile apps, Android 10+).
Off. Needed to keep a tunnel on until its app is closed from recent apps. Without it, the tunnel stops a few seconds after you leave the app. Main profile apps only.
Turn on app detection or usage access, or no rule can work.

Android doesn\'t show Quartz when apps in the work profile, private space or Secure Folder are closed, so their tunnel stops a few seconds after you leave them instead. A VPN only carries traffic of the profile it runs in: for those apps the rule still connects the tunnel, but their traffic goes through it only if that profile uses the same VPN. If an app is installed in more than one profile, the rule reacts to it in any of them.

Private space apps (and Secure Folder\'s on some phones) aren\'t listed, because Android shows them only to the launcher. With app detection on, open the app there once and it appears under “Seen in other profiles”.
Pick a tunnel and at least one app

Lets auto-tunnel connect a tunnel while chosen apps are open. Quartz only reads which app is in front (including apps in the work profile, private space and Secure Folder); it doesn\'t read what\'s on screen or act for you.
